primary_cause: Hyperscaler AI infrastructure demand is translating into record AI-server orders and shipment/revenue guidance.
counter_evidence: Supply constraints and high system complexity can cap realized shipments; not every ODM captures equal economics.
source_summary: Dell reported more than US$130B of AI-server orders in the past year and raised FY27 AI-server revenue guidance to US$74B; Foxconn reported sustained AI-rack volume growth and expects full-year AI rack shipments to more than double. Sources: Reuters 2026-09-01; Foxconn 2026-08-12.

primary_cause: AI infrastructure is shifting toward rack-scale integrated systems, with active mass production and capacity expansion.
counter_evidence: Accelerator/component allocation, customer qualification and integration complexity can delay rack conversion from demand to revenue.
source_summary: Foxconn expects Vera Rubin racks to enter mass production in Q3 and AI rack shipments to more than double for 2026; GIGABYTE is actively offering rack-scale GIGAPOD/AI-factory systems. Sources: Foxconn 2026-08-12; GIGABYTE 2026-03-02.

primary_cause: AI inference and large-scale data-center deployment are supporting NAND demand while supply remains constrained, lifting contract pricing.
counter_evidence: Record prices are damaging consumer affordability and could accelerate demand destruction outside enterprise/data-center applications.
source_summary: TrendForce forecasts 3Q26 NAND Flash contract prices +10-15% QoQ, primarily driven by AI inference and large-scale data-center deployments; TEAMGROUP reports continuing memory supply gaps and strong industrial/SI demand. Sources: TrendForce 2026-07-03; TEAMGROUP 2026-08-03.
